title: USA F-1 Student Visa from the UK | I-20 & Interview Help
description: USA F-1 student visa for studying at a US university or college: I-20, SEVIS fee, DS-160 and interview. Help from Manchester advisers.
h1: USA F-1 student visa from the UK
intro: The F-1 visa is for full-time study at a US university, college or language school. Your school issues a Form I-20 once you are accepted, which you need for your visa application. We prepare your F-1 student visa application and check every detail before it is submitted.

sections.heading: How the F-1 visa works
sections.text: Once your US school accepts you, it issues a Form I-20. You then pay the SEVIS fee, complete the DS-160 and attend a visa interview. You'll need to show you can pay for your studies and living costs.

sections.heading: The US visa interview
sections.text: Most US visas involve the online DS-160 form, paying the visa fee, and an interview at the US Embassy in London or the US Consulate in Belfast. Every answer on the DS-160 must be accurate and match your documents. We prepare your form and tell you what to take to the interview.

sections.heading: F-1 student visa help from Manchester
sections.text: We're based in Manchester city centre and help travellers and businesses across the UK. We check the rules for your passport, prepare your application and keep you updated until it's decided.

faqs.q: When can I apply for an F-1 visa?
faqs.a: Once you have your Form I-20 from your US school. Apply early, as interview waiting times vary.

faqs.q: Can I work on an F-1 visa?
faqs.a: Only in limited ways, such as some on-campus work. Ask your school’s international office.

faqs.q: How long does a F-1 student visa take?
faqs.a: Processing times vary with the authority and the time of year. Apply as early as you can, and don’t book non-refundable travel until your visa or authorisation is approved.

faqs.q: Can you help with my F-1 student visa application?
faqs.a: Yes. We check which visa fits your trip, prepare your F-1 student visa application and documents, and keep you updated. Contact us or call 0161 956 2003.
